description: Somos un grupo de estudiantes con curiosidad por la ciencia, el espacio y la tecnología. Nos unimos al NASA Space Apps Challenge con ganas de aprender, experimentar, trabajar en equipo y, sobre todo, divertirnos durante el proceso. Nuestro proyecto es Abandoned but not Forgotten, donde exploraremos la historia de los equipos y sondas que la humanidad ha dejado en el espacio.
summary:
THE TRACES WE LEFT BEHIND

Our project is an interactive digital platform that tells the story of the equipment and technology NASA has left throughout the Solar System since the 1960s. Through an interactive map, users can explore different destinations, discover the missions behind each artifact, learn why it was sent, where it is located, and whether it is still operational.

The platform uses publicly available NASA data, official images, videos, and audio to transform scientific information into an accessible and engaging experience. By combining historical records, multimedia resources, and interactive exploration, we aim to make space exploration easier to understand, especially for younger generations.

This project highlights the scientific and historical value of NASA's missions, showing how every piece of technology represents a step forward in humanity's exploration of space.
details: Our project consists of developing an interactive digital platform that allows users to explore and learn about the equipment, instruments, and technologies NASA has sent into space since the 1960s. The platform works through an interactive map where users can discover different objects, their origins, missions, scientific purposes, locations, and current operational status. The platform collects and organizes information from official NASA sources and publicly available datasets. It also incorporates multimedia resources, including photographs, videos, and audio, to create a more visual, dynamic, and accessible experience. Netlify was used to deploy and make the platform accessible online. One of the main benefits of our project is making space exploration more accessible to students and young people interested in science and technology. It also helps users understand that space missions leave behind important scientific and historical contributions, even after their original objectives have been completed. The expected impact is to encourage curiosity about astronomy, space technology, and scientific research while transforming complex information into an educational experience. The creative aspect of our project lies in presenting NASA's legacy from a different perspective. Instead of focusing only on famous missions, we highlight the equipment and objects that remain throughout the Solar System, telling their stories and explaining their importance. During development, our team considered the reliability of information, accessibility of public data, compatibility across different regions, ease of navigation, and clarity of content. We also aimed to make the platform useful for people without specialized knowledge of space exploration.
